created.description: UTC date and time when it was created in Relewise.

disabled.description: Whether it is disabled and therefore normally excluded from Search and Recommendations.

deleted.description: Whether it is marked as deleted. It may remain retrievable by Content ID until physically removed, after which it is returned as not found.

assortments.description: Assortment values used by filters to control visibility. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/assortments.html.

categoryPaths.description: Content Category paths, each from root to leaf.

dataValues.description: Up to 100 Data Values, selected by case-sensitive Data Key order. These are stored entity values, not Dataset metadata.

dataValuesTruncated.description: Whether DataValues contains fewer entries than DataKeys because Data Values are limited to 100.

description: Stored details and Data Values for one Content entity.
